text:
omar_sales: Heads up — Prospect (Clearwave Health) needs a quick compliance pack to move the POC into legal review. Can we assemble: 1) a signed attestation for an external vuln assessment (they called it a 'red-team sign-off'), 2) SOC 2 Type II scope summary (PDF, first 2 pages), 3) ISO 27001 certificate copy, 4) a redacted pen-test engagement sample, and 5) short answers to their 12-question security questionnaire. Also need a note on the pricing delta if they require Dedicated/Private hosting. Need by EOD tomorrow. @mira_security @raj_deveng

mira_security: Copy. I can pull SOC2 scope + ISO cert from the vault. For the attestation — do they need a wet signature or is a signed PDF enough? Also, we should provide guidance for how they can upload any scan outputs (presigned S3 or SFTP?).

infra_bot: deploy-bot: temp transfer bucket created: evidence-transfer-364159 (72h expiry).

raj_deveng: We have a redacted pen-test SOW snippet we can share. Quick Q: do they want a logical network diagram or full VPC details? We usually avoid sharing internal CIDRs.

mira_security: Signed PDF is fine — they asked for "signed attestation" so we'll sign a PDF. For uploads, presigned URL is preferred. @kelly_prod can you confirm what diagram scope we usually send to enterprise POCs?

kelly_prod: We send logical arch + egress/public IP ranges + SSO/SAML flow. Do NOT include private subnet CIDRs or internal hostnames. Also include a short bullet saying "no customer data retained in POC". For pricing note: if they require Dedicated/Private, estimate a 40–60% uplift on hosted rates — I'll add a conservative example number and link to the pricing sheet.

sasha_solutions: I can draft the short-answers doc for their 12 Qs. Please post the questionnaire here and I'll start filling it.

omar_sales: Copying their questionnaire below (redacted):
1) Do you have SOC 2 Type II?; 2) Is ISO 27001 certified?; 3) When was last external penetration test?; 4) Who performed it?; 5) Do you use SSO (SAML/OIDC)?; 6) How are keys managed for staging creds?; 7) Is PII stored during POC?; 8) Network isolation for tenants?; 9) Incident response SLA?; 10) Data residency options?; 11) Audit logs retention?; 12) Can we get a signed attestation/letter?

mira_security: Uploaded SOC/ISO to folder (internal link, restricted): https://drive.internal.redwood/s/clearwave-pack-364159 — drafting attestation now. ETA 15:00 PT. I'll include statement: "pen test performed within last 12 months" if vendor confirms.

infra_bot: presign-url generated: https://s3.internal.redwood/evidence-transfer-364159?token=REDACTED (72h).

raj_deveng: Attaching redacted SOW snippet we normally share:
```
Scope: External network and application assessment covering OWASP Top 10, auth/privilege escalation, and API surface. Findings are remediated per vendor report. Vendor redacted for PII.
Deliverables: Executive summary, technical report, remediation plan.
```

mira_security: OK final checklist: SOC2 summary (first 2 pages) + ISO cert + signed attestation PDF + redacted SOW + short-answers doc + presigned upload URL. I'll sign the attestation and drop a zip in the drive. One ask — do we need to include SOC2 auditor contact?

omar_sales: Summary only for now. If they request auditor contact, I'll escalate. Thanks all. Raising tracking ticket PRD-4432 for audit trail.

sasha_solutions: Starting answers now, will ping for clarifications on KMS and retention.

omar_sales: :thumbsup: Planning to send the package to the prospect by EOD once Mira confirms signed attestation and I get the short-answers doc.
